title: Q-LESSON-PATCH-GATE: Agent patches pass node --check and their tests before merge
body:

93 failure modes came from a code loop that edited very large files through search-and-replace windows and was checked for syntax only (invented anchors, corrupt splices, calls to undefined helpers).

Path: seed/worker/src/worker-gate.js

Acceptance: worker-gate.js passes an agent branch only when every changed .js file passes node --check, the tests next to it pass, and no file over 60 KB is edited by a model; test/worker-gate.test.mjs covers each refusal.
